message.reasoning_content:
Widgets Inc. is a known vendor on file since March 2023.

An earlier invoice INV-1001 failed payment with no disposition. The duplicate check returned no match, suggesting this may be a resubmission. The document itself shows the prior failure, which could justify rejection under policy.

The invoice itself does not show a duplicate problem. The prior failure is only visible in vendor history. A resubmission of a failed payment should be approved, since the original payment never went through and no one resolved it.

The low-risk memo does not block payment. No findings were raised, and the invoice math checks out.

The invoice total of $5,000 is mathematically consistent. The due date falls on February 1 instead of the expected January 30 under Net 15 terms, but this minor discrepancy does not constitute a finding. Because the amount is below $10,000, extra scrutiny requirements do not apply.

I will approve payment. The prior failed invoice was never resolved, so this is a resubmission of an unpaid bill rather than a duplicate payment.
